title: Fixed-batch optimization with unmodified repeat control and isolated timing window
claim: Removing duplicate outer checkpoint preserves fixed-batch loss and all gradients while improving synchronized forward/backward compute; inverse-CDF Beta retains specified distribution and avoids dirichlet fallback

protocol.input_description: One actual public LIBERO batch1; original converted weights; one real training augmentation reused exactly; explicit fixed noise and time=0.5; no parameter updates; all loss values and gradient tensors compared on CPU; two warmups/variant and six interleaved AB/BA repetitions with device sync; Beta separately 256 calls and 65536 sample CDF. Excludes data, augmentation and AdamW time. Adds an unmodified second backward to characterize native repeat variation; other NPU checks are not run concurrently.
protocol.acceptance: Report exact loss/gradient equality and missing/nonfinite checks; record per-variant timing/peak memory and Beta output distribution without claiming full throughput, convergence or NVIDIA parity.
